analyst_view.overall: Ferencvaros are 3rd with four wins from four, including 2-0 at AC Milan, and a win would all but secure a top-eight place; Celje are 25th with 4 points and fighting to stay in the play-off places. Balazs Borbely's side lost 3-1 at home to ETO on Saturday, ending a 22-match unbeaten run, and he blamed defensive and goalkeeping errors he called unusual. Bamidele Yusuf is banned after his red card in Milan, which the numbers already count (about -17% on Ferencvaros's goals). Celje won 2-0 at home on Sunday with defender Tutyskinas in the side; an earlier report of a UEFA yellow-card ban for him could not be confirmed and the numbers no longer list it. News on Celje was thin, no full match preview was out yet and no referee is named.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals and already take a big slice off Ferencvaros for Yusuf's ban, with Lenny Joseph, who scored both goals in Milan, expected to lead the line. Saturday's 1-3 loss to ETO showed some defensive wobbles, but Ferencvaros had conceded just 3 in their previous six and nothing new points either way, so I stay at 3.0.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners, already up a little because Celje have conceded 43 in their last six. Ferencvaros will have most of the ball at home, which the split (5.4 to 3.9) already shows, so I stay at 9.2.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards, already trimmed for both sides' calm recent card counts (Celje drew only 8 bookings from opponents in six). Yusuf's red in Milan came from a late elbow rather than a heated game, and no referee is named yet, so I stay at 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.3 shots, with Celje's quieter recent shooting (49 in six) already taking 11% off their side. Celje's win on Sunday came with their usual starters (Verbic and Seslar scored), so no rotation is in sight, and I stay at 25.3.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target, already raised for Ferencvaros's sharp recent finishing (31 on target in six). With no new absences found beyond Yusuf's ban, which the numbers count, I stay at 9.6.
